registers.name: GICR_PARTIDR
registers.description: Set PARTID and PMG Register。GIC Redistributor (GICR) 寄存器

fields.name: PMG
fields.description: PMG value used when 再分发器 访问 memory. Bits not needed to represent PMG values in the range 0 to PMG_MAX are RES0.

fields.name: PARTID
fields.description: PARTID value used when 再分发器 访问 memory. Bits not needed to represent PARTID values in the range 0 to PARTID_MAX are RES0.
